metadata.question: There was a volcanic plume visible over Mount Etna at 1:37 am local time on February 23, 2021. Did the plume go to the western side?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to find satellite imagery of Mount Etna on February 23, 2021, around 1:37 AM local time (00:37 UTC) - Mount Etna is in Sicily, Italy (approximately 37.75°N, 15.00°E) - For nighttime/early morning detection, I should check multiple sources: * Sentinel-2 (daytime optical - unlikely at 1:37 AM) * Landsat (daytime optical - unlikely at 1:37 AM) * MODIS Terra/Aqua (multiple daily passes, thermal bands) * VIIRS (daily, thermal detection possible) - Since this is 1:37 AM, I need satellites with thermal capability or near that time - VIIRS and MODIS are best for detecting volcanic plumes with thermal bands 2. Masking strategy: - The question IS about the plume, so I should NOT mask clouds - I need to detect the plume direction using thermal anomalies or aerosol/SO2 data - Use thermal bands or aerosol indices to identify plume - Compare values on western vs eastern side of the volcano 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If no images found around that time → C1 - If images exist but no valid pixels → C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN → C3 - If plume detected on western side → A (Yes) - If plume detected on eastern side or no clear western plume → B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Mount Etna location const etna = ee.Geometry.Point([15.00, 37.75]); const roi = etna.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer // February 23, 2021 - checking a window around 1:37 AM local time (00:37 UTC) const targetDate = '2021-02-23'; const startDate = '2021-02-22'; const endDate = '2021-02-24'; // Try VIIRS for thermal detection (better temporal resolution) let viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(etna); console.log('VIIRS Images found:', viirs.size().getInfo()); // If no VIIRS, try MODIS Terra if (viirs.size().getInfo() === 0) { viirs = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(etna); console.log('MODIS Terra Images found:', viirs.size().getInfo()); } // If still no data, try Sentinel-5P for SO2 (volcanic plume indicator) if (viirs.size().getInfo() === 0) { const s5p = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_SO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(etna) .select('SO2_column_number_density'); console.log('Sentinel-5P SO2 Images found:', s5p.size().getInfo()); if (s5p.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No satellite data found for the time period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Use SO2 data to detect plume const so2Image = s5p.mean(); // Define western and eastern zones const westZone = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([14.90, 37.70, 15.00, 37.80]); const eastZone = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([15.00, 37.70, 15.10, 37.80]); // Calculate SO2 in each zone const westStats = so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: westZone, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const eastStats = so2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: eastZone, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const westMean = westStats.SO2_column_number_density_mean; const westCount = westStats.SO2_column_number_density_count; const eastMean = eastStats.SO2_column_number_density_mean; const eastCount = eastStats.SO2_column_number_density_count; console.log('West SO2:', westMean, 'Pixels:', westCount); console.log('East SO2:', eastMean, 'Pixels:', eastCount); if (westCount === 0 && eastCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (westMean === null || westMean === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if western plume is stronger if (westMean > eastMean && westMean > 0.0001) { console.log('Plume detected on western side.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Plume not primarily on western side.'); console.log('B'); } return; } // Use thermal data from VIIRS/MODIS const thermalImage = viirs.mean(); // Define western and eastern zones from volcano const westZone = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([14.90, 37.70, 15.00, 37.80]); const eastZone = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([15.00, 37.70, 15.10, 37.80]); const bandName = viirs.first().bandNames().getInfo()[0]; const westStats = thermalImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: westZone, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const eastStats = thermalImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: eastZone, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const westCount = westStats[bandName + '_count']; const eastCount = eastStats[bandName + '_count']; if (westCount === 0 && eastCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in analysis zones.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const westVal = westStats[bandName + '_mean']; const eastVal = eastStats[bandName + '_mean']; console.log('West thermal:', westVal, 'Pixels:', westCount); console.log('East thermal:', eastVal, 'Pixels:', eastCount); if (westVal === null || westVal === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (westVal > eastVal) { console.log('Thermal anomaly stronger on west side.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Thermal anomaly not primarily western.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
